scheme_detail.policy_history_desc: Inspect past and present Gazetted rulesets governing entitlement rules.
scheme_detail.policy_versions_subtitle: Entitlement decisions are governed by time-bounded official Gazette orders. YogyataMitra deterministically resolves the version effective as of your evaluation date.
scheme_detail.pm_kisan_who_for: Eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to the applicable scheme exclusions.
scheme_detail.pm_kisan_key_criteria: Ownership of cultivable land by the farmer family, subject to scheme exclusions (including institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, government employees/pensioners with pension >= ₹10,000, income tax payees, professionals, and post-cutoff transfers without inheritance).
scheme_detail.ssy_who_for: Parents or legal guardians opening an account in the name of an Indian resident girl child from birth up to age 10.
scheme_detail.ssy_key_criteria: Beneficiary must be a girl child; age must not exceed 10 years at account opening; maximum two accounts per family (with statutory multiple-birth exceptions); natural or court-appointed legal guardian required.
scheme_detail.what_assesses_desc: YogyataMitra evaluates the information provided by you against official statutory Gazette orders and certified ministerial operational guidelines.
scheme_detail.what_cannot_guarantee_desc: YogyataMitra provides eligibility and policy evaluation assistance. Final entitlement, sanction, benefit delivery, payment/disbursement, account crediting, and official enrollment remain exclusively under the statutory jurisdiction of the competent Government authorities.

trust.section_subtitle: Delivering transparency, trust, and auditability to every citizen.
trust.pillar1_desc: Evaluations execute through a certified rules engine with zero arbitrary discretion.
trust.pillar2_desc: Every condition links to authoritative Gazette notifications and ministry guidelines.
trust.pillar3_desc: All scheme rulesets are officially versioned and protected against unauthorized modification.
trust.pillar4_desc: Every eligibility check generates a recorded evaluation trace with full explainability.

how_it_works.title: How YogyataMitra Works
how_it_works.subtitle: A transparent four-step statutory evaluation process for citizens.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Enter relevant household, landholding, or family facts for the selected scheme.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Record documentary evidence pointers (land records, certificates, IDs).
how_it_works.step3_desc: The engine applies the statutory policy version effective on your evaluation date.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Receive a transparent 5-state determination with full rule-by-rule breakdown.

results.MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED_desc: This case involves an exceptional condition or statutory exception requiring human review.
results.why_result_desc: This determination is strictly derived from statutory rules. Inspect the rule-by-rule audit breakdown below:
results.criteria_satisfied_desc: All statutory criteria required for this determination have been satisfied.

forms.pm_kisan_facts_heading: PM-KISAN Statutory Fact Requirements (Landholding & Household Exclusions):
forms.pm_kisan_land_label: Does the farmer family own cultivable land?
forms.pm_kisan_institutional_label: Is the landholder an institutional entity?
forms.pm_kisan_constitutional_label: Does any family member hold/held a constitutional post?
forms.pm_kisan_representative_label: Is any member a Minister, MP, MLA, MLC, Mayor, or Zila Panchayat Chairperson?
forms.pm_kisan_govt_emp_label: Is any member a serving or retired government/public sector employee (excluding Class IV/MTS)?
forms.pm_kisan_pensioner_label: Does any retired pensioner receive monthly pension of ₹10,000 or higher?
forms.pm_kisan_tax_label: Did any family member pay Income Tax in the last assessment year?
forms.pm_kisan_professional_label: Is any member a practicing Doctor, Engineer, Lawyer, Chartered Accountant, or Architect?
forms.pm_kisan_nri_label: Is the farmer family a Non-Resident Indian (NRI) family?
forms.pm_kisan_transfer_label: Was land transferred after the statutory cutoff date (01-Feb-2019)?
forms.pm_kisan_succession_label: Was the land transfer acquired strictly via succession / inheritance?

forms.ssy_natural_guardian_label: Is the applicant the natural guardian (Mother or Father)?

next_actions.title: Recommended Next Actions
next_actions.subtitle: What you should do based on this statutory determination:
next_actions.eligible_heading: You appear eligible based on the information provided.
next_actions.eligible_desc: Eligibility assessment is an advisory policy check and is not the final Government sanction or benefit approval. To enroll and receive scheme benefits, proceed through the official Government application portal or designated authority.
next_actions.document_guidance: Keep the documents or information requested by the competent Government authority available for the next stage of the official process.
next_actions.eligible_offline: You may also visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or designated local office.
next_actions.ssy_offline_note: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA) is opened in person at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch. Online application is not available.
next_actions.ineligible_desc: Based on the information provided, one or more mandatory statutory criteria or exclusions were not satisfied. You may review your answers, explore other supported schemes, or consult the official gazette guidelines.
next_actions.insufficient_heading: More information is needed before eligibility can be determined.
next_actions.insufficient_desc: One or more required statutory facts were not provided. Please provide the missing information to allow the evaluation engine to reach a definitive determination.
next_actions.verification_desc: The information provided requires supporting documentary verification by the designated authority before final statutory entitlement can be confirmed.
next_actions.verification_disclaimer: Verification confirms the validity of submitted documents; it does not by itself guarantee scheme entitlement.
next_actions.manual_heading: Your case requires review by the competent authority.
next_actions.manual_desc: Your case involves an exceptional circumstance or statutory condition that requires review by the appropriate competent authority.
next_actions.csc_locator_cta: Find a nearby Common Service Centre (CSC)

officer.policy_discovery_subtitle: Discovers candidate policy statements from official sources for authorized human review.
officer.policy_discovery_advisory_notice: AI-generated policy candidates are non-executable proposal data awaiting human inspection. Approving a candidate accepts it for future policy-authoring consideration and does NOT enact law or modify statutory rules.
officer.policy_discovery_approve_desc: Source is sufficient and concept is accepted for future controlled drafting.
officer.policy_discovery_reject_desc: Candidate statement is inaccurate, unverified, or legally inadmissible.
officer.policy_discovery_clarification_desc: Insufficient documentation, conflicting source, or ambiguous effective date.
officer.policy_discovery_in_review_desc: Begin active evaluation of source documents and legal clauses.
officer.policy_discovery_no_candidates: No policy discovery candidates match the selected filters.
officer.policy_discovery_archive_desc: Permanently transitions candidate to terminal ARCHIVED state.
officer.policy_authoring_subtitle: Statutory rule authoring, deterministic AST validation, Strong Kleene testing, and diffing
officer.policy_authoring_staged_warning: CONTROLLED POLICY ENVIRONMENT: Staged policies are placed into a verified quarantine state ready for future activation workflows. STAGED IS NOT ACTIVE. No citizen evaluations are affected.
officer.policy_authoring_sep_duties_desc: The author of a draft cannot conduct supervisory review or stage their own policy draft. Another supervisor must review.
officer.policy_authoring_reason_required: Substantive justification reason (minimum 5 characters) is mandatory.
